notes.title: Hot Plates now supports Windows 32-bit
notes.content:
We've decided that Hot Plates needs to support Windows 32-bit Systems. Let us know if you have any Problems with the new Version. We need your Feedback to further improve the game. 

Have Fun. ːpegiː

notes.title: Hot Plates 1.03
notes.content:
Overall Balancing Patch

+balanced success demand over time
+the amount of customers is greatly reduced
+Late-Game should still be a challenging experience

Bug Fixes:

-fixed names from upgrades in journal not showing up
-fixed error looking at machines
-fixed error looking at upgrades
-fixed issue: description-text in journal is cut-off
-fixed bug: Ager and other big machines are disappearing after restart

Thanks for all the Feedback from the Community. :)

notes.title: Hot Plates 1.02.4
notes.content:
New Features:

+Tutorial texts are now colorized
+Menu at the end of the day now is skippable
+Hydrofarms show how long the crops needs to grow

Bugfixes:

-Language setting starting in german (not really tested, we need more Feedback on that one)
-The crop-timer in Hydrofarms reset in some occasions
-Upgrades are not displaying in the Journal

The sprinting also got some fixes.
